rationale: For a community knowledge base handling verified information, trust and clarity are paramount. Combining strict Swiss minimalism (grid alignments, stark off-white/black contrast, 1px borders) with Editorial typography (large serif headings) creates an authoritative 'digital newspaper/curated platform' feel. This avoids generic SaaS aesthetics.

instructions_to_main_agent.font_imports: Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_creation: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily override them. Remove border-radius (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`), replace soft shadows with solid borders, and enforce the high-contrast color scheme. Go cardless where possible to create an editorial flow.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx extensions. Do not use .tsx.

typography.primary_font_usage: Used ONLY for prominent headings (H1/H2) like Question Titles and Page Headers to provide an authoritative, published feel. Never used for UI elements.
typography.secondary_font_usage: Used for all standard UI, body text, metadata, tags, inputs, and buttons. Clean and geometric, providing high readability.

hierarchy.h1: font-serif text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#111110]
hierarchy.h2: font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight text-[#111110]
hierarchy.small_label: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#666661]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow content to breathe. Use negative space instead of heavy borders to group elements where possible.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style layouts for admin/analytics (gap-4 or gap-6). Asymmetric or editorial layouts for marketing/home (gap-8 to gap-16).

surface_styles.cards: bg-white border border-[#E6E6E1] rounded-none shadow-none transition-colors
surface_styles.buttons_primary: bg-[#111110] text-white hover:bg-[#004B87] px-6 py-3 rounded-none text-sm font-medium tracking-wide transition-all
surface_styles.buttons_secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E6E6E1] text-[#111110] hover:bg-[#F9F9F8] hover:border-[#111110] px-6 py-3 rounded-none text-sm font-medium transition-all
surface_styles.inputs: bg-white border border-[#E6E6E1] rounded-none px-4 py-3 text-base focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#111110] focus:border-[#111110] outline-none
surface_styles.tags: bg-[#F9F9F8] border border-[#E6E6E1] text-[#666661] text-[10px] sm:text-xs px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none font-medium

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Interactive surfaces get a subtle background shift (to #F0F0EE) or border darkening. Text remains high contrast.

icons.style: stroke-width: 1.5. Keep icons un-filled to match the clean, line-art aesthetic of the Swiss theme.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="search-submit-button"`, `data-testid="upvote-question-btn"`).

home_question_feed.layout: 2-column grid: Main content (Feed) spanning 8 columns, Right Sidebar spanning 4 columns.
home_question_feed.components: Prominent top search bar with large padding. Question cards feature a vertical voting block on the left (chevron-up, count, chevron-down). Main card area: Serif H2 for title, truncated description, tags at bottom, author/time at bottom right. Sidebar features 'Trending Topics' and 'Top Contributors'.

search_results.layout: Sidebar-left layout: Filters (3 cols) + Results (9 cols).
search_results.components: Large Serif 'Search Results for X'. Filter section includes Status (Answered, Unanswered, Verified), Category, Date. Empty state: minimalist text layout with prominent 'Ask a Question' primary CTA.

question_detail.layout: Main content (9 cols) + Context Sidebar (3 cols for Related).
question_detail.components: Question Header: Massive Serif H1, Author profile block. Content block. Answers section separated by strict horizontal lines (`border-t border-[#E6E6E1]`). Accepted answer highlighted with `border-l-4 border-[#004B87] bg-[#F9F9F8]` to immediately draw the eye. Rich text formatting for code, lists.

ask_question.layout: Single centered column, max-w-3xl for focus.
ask_question.components: Form with distinct separation. Title input is massive (text-2xl or 3xl) placeholder 'What do you need to know?'. 'Similar questions' widget slides in dynamically under the title input. WYSIWYG editor for description. Drag-and-drop file attachment zone (dashed border).

login.layout: Split screen. Left: 50% width pure white form container. Right: 50% width architectural background image.
login.components: Massive 'Welcome' Serif heading. Stacked inputs. Full-width primary CTA.

signup.components: Simple stacked inputs. Prominent 'Join the Community' text.

user_profile.layout: Top hero banner (off-white bg, no heavy colors) + bottom content.
user_profile.components: Hero contains large Avatar, Name, Reputation Score, Join Date. Content below is a pure tabbed interface (`border-b` style tabs): Questions, Answers, Saved. Lists reuse the Question Card component.

notifications.components: Simple list view. Unread items have a faint `#004B87` left border and bold text. Mark all as read secondary button at top.

admin_dashboard.components: Top: Bento grid of 4 key metrics (Total Qs, As, Users, Flagged). Middle: Two charts (Activity over time). Bottom: Recent user signups/activity feed.

analytics_page.layout: Full width with dense bento grid.
analytics_page.components: Charts for Most Viewed Questions, Most Searched Topics, Engagement Rates. Use clean, monochrome charts (Shadcn/Recharts) with `#004B87` as the primary data color.

reports_moderation.components: Dense tabular layout. Columns: Flagged Item, Reason, Reporter, Action. Actions are tight group of small buttons (Approve, Reject, Delete).

categories_topics.components: Large rectangular cards with border. Category Name in Serif, Question count, small description, and top 3 tags listed at the bottom.
